propositions: The webhook and rerun endpoint secrets are passed as query parameters (?token=...) and logged in plaintext in uvicorn access logs, exposing them to journald and anything that reads the journal.

The webhook token is derived from GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN (the review bot's Gerrit credential) when WEBHOOK_TOKEN is not set, making the exposure a credential compromise with blast radius extending to Gerrit authentication.

The fix moves authentication tokens from query parameters to the X-Rebar-Token HTTP header, which is not recorded in access logs, and installs a TokenRedactingFilter as a backstop to scrub any remaining token= patterns from logs.
The currently-logged token must be rotated independently of the code fix, and rotation must be tracked explicitly before merging the fix to prevent the new token from being logged on first use.
Access logs must still record route and status for observability and debugging purposes after the fix is applied.
